text: Focus heavily on Data Structures (Trees, Graphs, Hash Maps), SQL queries, and Object-Oriented Programming. They also emphasize clean coding and explaining your thought process during problem solving.
Also review your 4th sem DBMS mini-project! In my round, they asked me to write SQL join queries on paper.
We used the ASL Alphabet dataset from Kaggle last semester along with MediaPipe for hand landmark detection. It runs in real-time even on standard laptop CPUs!
Please refer only to the official notices published here on Campus Voice. The lab examinations will commence from Nov 22nd. An official departmental circular will be uploaded by tomorrow.
